name: public_opinion_dynamic_plan_execute_ab
description: Fixed, transparent rubric for comparing the two committed workflow versions. Dimension coverage is lexical evidence screening; it is not a substitute for expert fact checking.
coverage_rule: A dimension is counted as covered only when the final report contains at least one configured dimension keyword. Results must be interpreted with the keyword hits and not as semantic proof.
unsupported_claim_rule: Sentence-level heuristic: candidate factual/risk sentences are counted unsupported when they contain dates, quantities, concrete allegations, regulatory outcomes, or risk conclusions but no nearby URL, source marker, citation marker, or explicit evidence qualifier.
conflict_rule: Conflict detection is counted when the report or Research Review explicitly compares public, official, regulatory, media, social, or internal evidence and marks agreement, inconsistency, contradiction, or unresolved verification.
